<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the forward electrophilic aromatic bromination (C–H → C–Br, forming a halide). To locate the appropriate template, we first retrieve the list of functional group names available in the database, then search the template catalog using criteria that a halide is formed and a hydrogen is broken. Once we obtain a matching template, we will retrieve its SMARTS and map the reaction to get the mapped reaction SMILES. Finally we will return the mapped reaction and the template's ID.</thought>
